label: Per se necessary esse, dependence sense (PER_SE_NECESSARY_2)
term: per se necessary esse, dependence sense
definition: An esse principle e is per se necessary at world w in the dependence sense when e satisfies the esse-existence predicate at w and nothing other than e is a cause of e's necessity (no c distinct from e with necessityFrom e c). Its negation for a conjunction is DependentConjunctionAt: the joining holds at w and depends on something. The modal proxy NecessaryEsseAt is not part of this definition; necessityFrom e e is not excluded.
note: Reading of SCG I's 'per se necesse' as necessary not through another (per se versus per aliud), matching n.3's framing of the objection as dependence ('dependet quantum ad coniunctionem') and n.2's clause 'si ab alio dependet, iam non est necesse esse'. That clause is NOT folded into this definition: it is the separate OPEN premise DependenceOnAnotherGivesNecessityFromIt, with a finite omission control. This sense sits on the underived side of DISAMB-NECESSARY-EXISTENCE-VS-UNDERIVED in spirit, but it is not identified with NecessarilyUnderived, which concerns existing supporters of a bearer rather than causes of an esse's necessity; no bridge between them is asserted. Attribution deferred: no SCG I.22 corpus passage has been materialized. Stipulative analyst sense; it would be sourced by a pinned SCG I.15/I.22 passage read for the per se/per aliud distinction.
